sources.title: GitHub - Piyushosti/maithali-poem
sources.snippet: A full-stack AI-powered application that generates poetry in the Maithili language. The project uses a dual-model approach, combining a custom-trained transformer and a fine-tuned Gemma 2B model to create culturally rich and contextually relevant poems.
